question: Under seven weightings of starts other than SCALE-SHARE's (bare random trees, with surplus at 25/50/100%, with Poisson(1) extra lines, knots added one at a time, a configuration model), frozen before any sample was classified, what share of starts of 5 to 20 knots lies in the proved class, what growth classes does the theorem predict there, and does three dimensions or exponential growth become common in the class?

public_inputs.run: scripts/longrun.py launch job.py; python3 -B merge.py <out dir> <results.json>
public_inputs.reused: SCALE-THEOREM scalelib.py (reader); DOUBLE-IDENT machine_check.py (class, growth, relayed model) and dims.py (growth class); joinlib bare_sizes

forbidden_inputs: Changing a weighting, a prediction, the class, the rule or the threshold for 'common' after reading the frozen run
primary_observable: W1-W11 of research/WEIGHTINGS-20261119-001/preregistration.md, and the per-weighting, per-size table
cheapest_meaningful_control: the bare tree's exact three-plus probabilities at n = 7 and 8 (W1) and its ray-leaf mean (W2); the stratified regrowth (W10)

predictions.W1: tree three-plus count of 2,000: 0 at n = 5, 6; 70-130 at 7; 31-73 at 8; more at 7 than 8
predictions.W2: tree mean ray-leaf count within 5% of (n-1)(1-2/n)^(n-3)
predictions.W3: tree and tree-sP: every sample in the class
predictions.W4: tree and tree-sP: no exponential sample
predictions.W5: tree three-plus > 10% of all at n = 16 and > 20% at n = 20
predictions.W6: tree+ exponential >= 10% of in-class growers at n >= 8; zero-extra stratum all in class, no exponential
predictions.W7: grow exponential > 50% of in-class growers at n >= 10 (>= 20 growers); three-plus < 2% everywhere
predictions.W8: n = 20 three-plus share of all: tree >= s25 >= s50 >= s100
predictions.W9: config: stall > 40% at every size; dim 2 >= 70% and three-plus < 2% of in-class growers where >= 20
predictions.W10: every regrown sample agrees round by round to round 6

decision_rules.common: three-plus or exponential >= 10% of in-class growers with >= 20 in-class growers at that weighting and size

stop_rule: One run; stop at the table, or at the first weighting and size where W10 fails.
runtime: about ten minutes on eight workers
disclosed_exploration: smoke tests with seeds marked -smoke (3 samples per weighting at n = 5, 20; 15 samples per case; four cases of 60), output read only for errors and timings
